# Cartoon 3D Short Skill

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor: Turns one true story into a 55 to 70 second vertical cartoon short in a painted 3D town. Voice generation may need a paid TTS. It covers the script beats, voice timing, shot plan, world, characters, sound, look checks and final render, starting from the bridge short template.

The skill walks through the full pipeline from the SKILL.md: facts and script beats, recorded or generated voice with word timings, a shot plan copied from the bridge template, a painted 3D world, bean-head cartoon characters, sound and music, look checks against reference frames, then the final 2K vertical render and its quality checks. Videos come out English only, with no captions or labels on screen. It leans on companion files and the author's own Remotion project, described here only as the SKILL.md presents them, so examine them in the repo before use. By @mromidev, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Voice generation may need a paid TTS.
